messages:
marie: quick design ping on the private setup preflight card. on desktop the status badge is dominating the header, making the stepper feel secondary.

oscar: I noticed that too. maybe a left-rail compact indicator + inline status text would help the title stay primary.

felix: agree. also the current "More info" copy is vague. suggest "View probe details (diagnostics)" to set expectation.

ada: accessibility: color+icon only is risky. add an sr-only label and ensure keyboard users can expand details with Enter. aria-expanded + aria-controls recommended.

marie: for mobile, show only the first failing probe in the collapsed view so users can triage quickly. expand to show rest.

oscar: UX pattern idea: inline small "Run fix" action for each failing probe. modal only for escalations. keeps users in flow.

felix: also debounce live updates to avoid VO spamming when probes refresh often. 1500-2000ms seems reasonable.

build-bot: [ci] ui/staging pushed: preflight-compact-actions v1.1 at 2025-06-05 16:12 UTC.

ada: I'll run contrast checks on the amber warning against the panel bg and share hexes in the ticket. if it fails WCAG we need a stronger border or darker fill.

marie: action items: (1) oscar to implement left indicator + inline status; (2) ada to add aria-expanded + sr-only strings and VO debounce; (3) felix to update microcopy; (4) i'll validate mobile collapsed-first-fail pattern. review Friday 9:30am.

oscar: filed TICKET-4299 with screenshots and a tiny gif of the collapse interaction.

marie: thanks team 384 this should make onboarding for private deployments smoother!
